sourceFirstFindings.status: Questions from source reading; not scientific verdicts or applied corrections

findings.finding: Universal ADC uptake/only-ADC and own-weapon statements conflict with product-specific and extracellular-release discussion; verify actual routes rather than importing universal categories.
Particle-range numbers need radionuclide, mean/maximum and tissue context; molecular retention and radiophysical action are separate.
PK tables require exact label version, species/specimen, median/mean/apparent definitions and units. The formation-limited explanation needs source/model support beyond a clearance contrast.
The solitomab post-discontinuation fatal-diarrhoea detail needs primary text; general irreversibility caution is not a universal product risk estimate.
Molecular HLA restriction must be separated from the trial disease/line/setting; not every population expansion requires a changed drug.
Resistance-level boxes can interact. Changing an address, potency, linker or payload is a hypothesis, not an automatic repair of the clinically observed failure.
Dual-payload joint-resistance probability, transcription-versus-noncycling claims, automatic durable immune activation and chemistry-escape statements need qualification or actual evidence.

Potency in one assay does not scale marrow effects by the same ratio. Biomarker-concentrated response does not alone prove predictive validity or mechanism; scattered responses do not alone disprove it.
Universal absent-trial/almost-none/only-delivery-strategy claims require a bounded search or named evidence-gap alternative.
Static target-copy counts, format density thresholds and normal-tissue staining cannot alone define delivered dose or a comparative therapeutic window.
The target table combines different assays, cohorts and products; its winner/safer/failed-target language is not a direct comparison.
Current US indications, no-assay claims, registry phases/recruitment/completion and label warnings need live authoritative checks, separate from the dated source assertions.
The relocated originals contain a two-model controlled-delivery example and operational clock details; retain them independently of newer PK examples.
Source metadata self-attests source checking; expert/learner review remains pending. Both personal-application bodies remain excluded and private.
The Tomabechi citation date and all recalled/named paper identifiers must be independently resolved. A real identifier or framework review does not establish every attached claim.
Original index wording says all three lessons although its core table has five; course-routing metadata and durations are not treatment timing or new science.

dispositions.ST-SF01: Product-specific uptake and extracellular release replace universal categories.
dispositions.ST-SF02: Isotope-specific approximate ranges retain the actual table convention.
dispositions.ST-SF03: Named label parameters and release-limited MMAE example; no intrinsic DXd half-life from clearance alone.
dispositions.ST-SF04: The solitomab abstract supports the fatal post-discontinuation event only in that study.
dispositions.ST-SF05: Molecular HLA restriction differs from another clinical setting.
dispositions.ST-SF06: The failure boxes remain overlapping hypotheses.
dispositions.ST-SF07: No low joint-resistance probability, guaranteed quiescent-cell killing or durable immunity.
dispositions.ST-SF08: Fictional potency and marker-response observations do not establish human benefit or proportional harm.
dispositions.ST-SF09: Bounded read-study statements replace global absence; ST4-014 remains source-open.
dispositions.ST-SF10: Static counts, loading and staining are not delivery or safety thresholds.
dispositions.ST-SF11: Different assays, cohorts and products cannot rank intrinsic targets.
dispositions.ST-SF12: Current labels and registries distinguish selection, recruitment, results and availability.
dispositions.ST-SF13: Original A/B direction and three clocks retained; draft inversion fixed before application.
dispositions.ST-SF14: Self-attested checks give no expert/learner approval; personal bodies excluded.
dispositions.ST-SF15: Identifiers resolved, Tomabechi dated 2022, and three formal notices disposed.
dispositions.ST-SF16: Five-lesson/72-minute and six-lesson/86-minute routing are course metadata.
